project: M-11 Digital Twin for Underground Mining Human-Machine Interaction

dataset.source: UCI AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance (synthetic base) + Underground Mining Telemetry Simulation
dataset.target_nature: Heuristic synthetic formula (82.07% spatial/kinematic variance explained; sigma=3.8)

ml_validation_protocol.resampling_strategy: SMOTENC (nested inside fold pipeline; never touches test or validation fold)
ml_validation_protocol.threshold_calibration: Max F2 (beta=2.0) on out-of-fold development probabilities
ml_validation_protocol.test_holdout_access: Evaluated exactly once with fixed calibrated threshold; zero retraining on test set
ml_validation_protocol.statistical_hypothesis_testing: Paired bootstrap (1000 resamples), exact paired McNemar test, Holm-Bonferroni correction, Cliff's delta
ml_validation_protocol.statistical_conclusion_policy: Distinguishes failure to reject H0 (p_Holm > 0.05 or CI containing 0) from formal equivalence (TOST)

safety_architecture.nature_of_interlock: Safety Advisory & Protocol Directives Engine (Operational mandates; does not physically actuate machinery PLC relays)
standards_enforced: D.S. 024-2016-EM Art. 103 / Art. 252 (CO Gas > 25 ppm / 50 ppm Evacuation)
D.S. 024-2016-EM Art. 367 / Art. 368 (Machine Failure & LOTO Lockout)
safety_architecture.llm_role: Advisory and explainability only; cannot override deterministic lockouts
